scope: Completed native feedback-tail diagnostic plus rejected coarse/fine support-tail search; no baseline promotion or new student result.

resolution_audit.scope:
Compare identical support references at two model integration resolutions.

This diagnoses discretization sensitivity, not agreement with native physics.
The fine saved trajectory and both source provenances are checked before use.
resolution_audit.limitation: The same feedback law may issue different targets after state trajectories diverge; these are not identical open-loop command sequences.

final_model_load_audit.scope:
Audit actual computed model loads, rather than treating four flags as load.

Replays the last ten saved fine-model intervals with an observational hook.
These are predicted impulses; no native contact-force measurement is implied.

test_result.scope: Reference continuity, zero-correction compatibility, limits and arm slew only; not physical validation.
